basic_info.description: Located in the highly desired Inner Richmond neighborhood, this upper level home boasts 2 bedrooms/1 bathroom and is approximately 1,438 sq/ft. As you enter, you'll notice an open floorplan with a family room featuring a wood burning fireplace with built-in cabinets on either side and large bay windows letting in plenty of natural light. Adjacent to the family room is a formal dining room with dual French doors and direct access to the kitchen. Kitchen is big enough for a breakfast table and includes a gas stove/oven, microwave and refrigerator with plenty of storage space. Next to the kitchen is a utility room featuring a stacked washer and dryer, utility sink, water heater and furnace, with stairway access to the garage, storage and backyard. The hallway leading to the bedrooms has an additional storage cabinet and utility closet. Both bedrooms face the backyard with the main bedroom featuring a walk-in closet with built in shelves and dresser with direct access to the bathroom. The garage has a generous amount of shared storage area, a private storage room, shared back room and room for one car. The shared backyard features lush landscaping, a sitting area with firepit and BBQ area. With a walkable score of 99/100, you are within walking distance to Golden Gate Park, neighborhood markets, restaurants, Safeway and public transportation. Highly motivated to close quickly!
